name: Gallant "Red Alert" Rifle
description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.
